verses.sloka: शुकेन तु समाख्याताम्स् तान् दृष्ट्वा हरि यूथपान् ।लक्ष्मणम् च महावीर्यम् भुजम् रामस्य दक्षिणम् ॥६-२९-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: śukena tu samākhyātāms tān dṛṣṭvā hari yūthapān ।lakṣmaṇam ca mahāvīryam bhujam rāmasya dakṣiṇam ॥6-29-1॥।।

translations.english: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्ड का अट्ठाइसवाँ सगे पूरा हुआ । —B— एकोनत्रिंशः सगः तन £ लान" शुकेन तु समाख्यातांस्तान्‌ दृष्टा हरियूथपान्‌ । समीपस्थं च रामस्य भ्रातर स्वं विभीषणम्‌

verses.sloka: समीपस्थम् च रामस्य भ्रातरम् स्वम् विभीषणम् ।सर्व वानर राजम् च सुग्रीवम् भीम विक्रमम् ॥६-२९-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: samīpastham ca rāmasya bhrātaram svam vibhīṣaṇam ।sarva vānara rājam ca sugrīvam bhīma vikramam ॥6-29-2॥।।

translations.english: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.

verses.sloka: अङ्गदम् चापि बलिनम् वज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजम् ।हनूमन्तम् च विक्रान्तम् जाम्बवन्तम् च दुर्जयम् ॥६-२९-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgadam cāpi balinam vajrahastātmajātmajam ।hanūmantam ca vikrāntam jāmbavantam ca durjayam ॥6-29-3॥।।

translations.english: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.

verses.sloka: सुषेणम् कुमुदम् नीलम् नलम् च प्लवगर्षभम् ।गजम् गवाक्षम् शरभम् वैन्दम् च द्विविदम् तथा ॥६-२९-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: suṣeṇam kumudam nīlam nalam ca plavagarṣabham ।gajam gavākṣam śarabham vaindam ca dvividam tathā ॥6-29-4॥।।

translations.english: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.

verses.sloka: किम्चिद् आविग्न हृदयो जात क्रोधः च रावणः ।भर्त्सयाम् आस तौ वीरौ कथा अन्ते शुक सारणौ ॥६-२९-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: kimcid āvigna hṛdayo jāta krodhaḥ ca rāvaṇaḥ ।bhartsayām āsa tau vīrau kathā ante śuka sāraṇau ॥6-29-5॥।।

translations.english: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt) and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.
translations.hindi: इनको देख कर रावण मन ही मन कुछ कुऊ उद्विग्न हुआ अर जब शुक सारण ने अपना कथन£समाप्त किआ, तब उसने क्रोध में भर, उन दोनों वीर शुक सारण की भत्संना को श्रोत्‌ डाटा डपटा

verses.sloka: अधो मुखौ तौ प्रणताव् अब्रवीत् शुक सारणौ ।रोष गद्गदया वाचा सम्रब्धः परुषम् वचः ॥६-२९-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: adho mukhau tau praṇatāv abravīt śuka sāraṇau ।roṣa gadgadayā vācā samrabdhaḥ paruṣam vacaḥ ॥6-29-6॥।।

translations.english: (That Ravana) with his throat choked with anger spoke indignantly and harshly to both Suka and Saarana who stood with their heads bent down in supplication.
translations.hindi: PR Corn २५२ : युद्धकाण्डे शुक और सारण अत्यन्त नब्रतापूबक सिर झुकाए खड़े थे । परन्तु रावण क्रोध में भर उनसे वडे कठोर वचन. कहने लेगा

verses.sloka: न तावत् सदृशम् नाम सचिवैर् उपजीविभिः ।विप्रियम् नृपतेर् वक्तुम् निग्रह प्रग्रहे विभोः ॥६-२९-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: na tāvat sadṛśam nāma sacivair upajīvibhiḥ ।vipriyam nṛpater vaktum nigraha pragrahe vibhoḥ ॥6-29-7॥।।

translations.english: "It is not proper for those ministers dependent on a capable ruler who has the power to check and hold forth, to speak that which is unpleasant."
translations.hindi: तुम लोगों ने मुझसे जैसे वचन कहे हैं, वैसे वचन क्या क्रिसी वेतनभोगी सचिव को अपने उस स्वामी के सामने, जो निग्रह अनुग्रह करने में समर्थ है, कहना उचित है ?

verses.sloka: रिपूणाम् प्रतिकूलानाम् युद्ध अर्थम् अभिवर्तताम् ।उभाभ्याम् सदृशम् नाम वक्तुम् अप्रस्तवे स्तवम् ॥६-२९-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: ripūṇām pratikūlānām yuddha artham abhivartatām ।ubhābhyām sadṛśam nāma vaktum aprastave stavam ॥6-29-8॥।।

translations.english: "Is it appropriate for both of you to praise the enemy this way before war?"
translations.hindi: युद्ध के लिए प्रस्तुत एवं अपने बिरांधी शत्रुओं की इस प्रकार अनवसर प्रशंसा करना; कया तुम दोनों को उचित था ?

verses.sloka: आचार्या गुरवो वृद्धा वृथा वाम् पर्युपासिताः ।सारम् यद् राज शास्त्राणाम् अनुजीव्यम् न गृह्यते ॥६-२९-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: ācāryā guravo vṛddhā vṛthā vām paryupāsitāḥ ।sāram yad rāja śāstrāṇām anujīvyam na gṛhyate ॥6-29-9॥।।

translations.english: "You have not grasped that which is the essence of political wisdom in the sastras in spite of waiting upon elders, teachers and parents which was in vain."

verses.sloka: गृहीतो वा न विज्ञातो भारो ज्ञानस्य वा उच्यते ।ईदृशैः सचिवैर् युक्तो मूर्खैर् दिष्ट्या धरामि अहम् ॥६-२९-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: gṛhīto vā na vijñāto bhāro jñānasya vā ucyate ।īdṛśaiḥ sacivair yukto mūrkhair diṣṭyā dharāmi aham ॥6-29-10॥।।

translations.english: "Even if you have grasped you have not understood the meaning or out of intensity of your ignorance. Or else I am bearing foolish ones like you who are not fit to be ministers. Out of good luck I am ruling this sovereignty."
translations.hindi: आचार्या गुखो बद्धा बृथा वां पयंपास्षिताः । सार यद्राजशास्राणामनंजीव्यं न शृह्यते।। & ॥ छिः! आज तक आचाय, गुरु ओर वद्धजनां के पांस रह कर तुमने भाड़ ही भोका । एक वेतन मोगी को जो. समस्त राज- नीति की मुख्य मख्य बातें सीखनी उचित हैं--वे भी तुमने न सीखीं ॥ & ।। ` गृहीतो वा न विज्ञातो भारो ज्ञानस्य वोह्यते । ईदृशैः सचिपैय क्तो मूर्ख दिश्या धराम्यहम्‌ ॥ १०.॥ यदि सीखीं भी तो उनका मर्म तुमने न जाना। तुम तो केवल अज्ञान का बोझ ढो रहे हो । अथात्‌ तुम पल्लेसिरे के अज्ञानी हो ! इसे मैं अपना सौभाग्य ही समझता हूँ कि, तुम जैसे मूख मंत्रियों को, अपने पास रख कर भौ, में आज तक राज्य कर रहा हूँ

verses.sloka: किम् नु मृत्योर् भयम् न अस्ति माम् वक्तुम् परुषम् वचः ।यस्य मे शासतो जिह्वा प्रयच्चति शुभ अशुभम् ॥६-२९-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: kim nu mṛtyor bhayam na asti mām vaktum paruṣam vacaḥ ।yasya me śāsato jihvā prayaccati śubha aśubham ॥6-29-11॥।।

translations.english: "Did you not have fear of death when you spoke such harsh words to me, who can by mere order make good or evil to you?"
translations.hindi: अरे ! क्या तुमको अपनी जान जाने का ज़रा भी भय नहीं, जो तुमने मुझसे ऐसे कठोर वचन कहे ! क्यो तुम नहीं जानंते लोगों का मरना जीना मेरी जिह्वा के हिलते डुलने पर अर्थात्‌ मेरी आज्ञा पर निभर है.

verses.sloka: अपि एव दहनम् स्पृष्ट्वा वने तिष्ठन्ति पादपाः ।राज दोष परामृष्टास् तिष्ठन्ते न अपराधिनः ॥६-२९-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: api eva dahanam spṛṣṭvā vane tiṣṭhanti pādapāḥ ।rāja doṣa parāmṛṣṭās tiṣṭhante na aparādhinaḥ ॥6-29-12॥।।

translations.english: "Trees may remain unscathed even on touching forest fire, but those who are punishable do not remain unpunished on account of the king and are treated harshly."
translations.hindi: जदोषपराम्‌ः | यह तुम लोग भलीमाँति जान रखो कि, वन में आग लगने पर, उस वन के वृत्त भले ही भस्म होने से बच जाँय, किन्तु राज- द्रोह के अपराधी कभी नहीं वच सकते

verses.sloka: हन्याम् अहम् इमौ पापौ शत्रु पक्ष प्रशम्सकौ ।यदि पूर्व उपकारैर् मे न क्रोधो मृदुताम् व्रजेत् ॥६-२९-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: hanyām aham imau pāpau śatru pakṣa praśamsakau ।yadi pūrva upakārair me na krodho mṛdutām vrajet ॥6-29-13॥।।

translations.english: "I would have slayed these two sinners who praise the enemy side, if my anger had not softened and remembered their earlier services."

verses.sloka: अपध्वम्सत गच्चध्वम् सम्निकर्षाद् इतो मम ।न हि वाम् हन्तुम् इच्चामि स्मरन्न् उपकृतानि वाम् ॥६-२९-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: apadhvamsata gaccadhvam samnikarṣād ito mama ।na hi vām hantum iccāmi smarann upakṛtāni vām ॥6-29-14॥।।

translations.english: "You get away from here, disappear from here. On the contrary since I remember your earlier actions performed by you, I do not wish to kill you. Indeed, both of you are devoid of love and are ungrateful. You stand killed (already)."
translations.hindi: आँखों के सामते से इट जाओ, खबरदार अब तुम मेरी आंखों के सामने से इट , छु फ्रि मेरे सामने मत आना । मैं तुम्हें मारना नहीं चाहता । क्योंकि मुझे तुम्हारे उपकारों का स्मरण बना हुआ हे

verses.sloka: हताव् एव कृतघ्नौ तौ मयि स्नेह परान् मुखौ ।एवम् उक्तौ तु सव्रीडौ ताव् उभौ शुक सारणौ ॥६-२९-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: hatāv eva kṛtaghnau tau mayi sneha parān mukhau ।evam uktau tu savrīḍau tāv ubhau śuka sāraṇau ॥6-29-15॥।।

translations.english: Ravana, having spoken that way, both Suka and Saarana felt shy and withdrew from speaking words of praise of Ravana saying, 'Let you be victorious'.
translations.hindi: पछ २% युडूकाण तुम लोग जैसे कृतन्न और मेरे प्रति स्नेहशून्य दो रहे हो, इससे तो तुम निश्चय ही मार डालने योग्य हो । जब रावण ने डन दोनों शुक सारण से इस प्रकार कहा, तत्र वे बहत लज्जित हुए

verses.sloka: रावणम् जय शब्देन प्रतिनन्द्य अभिनिह्सृतौ ।अब्रवीत् स दशग्रीवः समीपस्थम् महाउदरम् ॥६-२९-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇam jaya śabdena pratinandya abhinihsṛtau ।abravīt sa daśagrīvaḥ samīpastham mahāudaram ॥6-29-16॥।।

translations.english: Ravana, the tenheaded one, then said to Mahodara who was standing nearby swiftly bring spies who are experts in policy to me.
translations.hindi: तब राक्षसेश्वर रावण ने उनको विश्वस्त) शूर, अपने -में _भक्तिमान और शात्रु,भय से निभय जान कर कहा

verses.sloka: उपस्थापय शीघ्रम् मे चारान् नीति विशारदान् ।महोदरस्तथोक्तस्तु शीघ्रमाज्ञापयच्चरान् ॥६-२९-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: upasthāpaya śīghram me cārān nīti viśāradān ।mahodarastathoktastu śīghramājñāpayaccarān ॥6-29-17॥।।

translations.english: (Ravana) Having said so, Mahodara ordered the spies to approach the king quickly. On reaching they greeted the king with folded hand s promoting h i m to' be victorious' and stood.

verses.sloka: ततश्चाराः सम्त्वरिताः प्राप्ताः पार्थिवशासनात् ।उपस्थिथाः प्राञ्जलयो वर्धयित्वा जयाशिषः ॥६-२९-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: tataścārāḥ samtvaritāḥ prāptāḥ pārthivaśāsanāt ।upasthithāḥ prāñjalayo vardhayitvā jayāśiṣaḥ ॥6-29-18॥।।

translations.english: (Ravana) Having said so, Mahodara ordered the spies to approach the king quickly. On reaching they greeted the king with folded hand s promoting h i m to' be victorious' and stood.
translations.hindi: है ततथारा; सन्त्वरिता; प्राप्ताः पाथिवशासनात्‌ । उपस्थिताः ग्राञ्जलयो वर्धयित्वा जयाशिषा ।:१८ ॥ रावणकी आज्ञा सुनते ही चर लोग तुरन्त ही उसके पास जा पहुँचे और “ जय हो ” ऐसा आशीर्वाद दे, हाथ जोड़े हुए खड़े हो गए

verses.sloka: तान् अब्रवीत् ततो वाक्यम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः ॥६-२९-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: tān abravīt tato vākyam rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ ॥6-29-19॥।।

translations.english: There upon the Lord of Rakshasas, spoke these words to those spies who are dependable ones, warriors devoid of fear of enemies.

verses.sloka: चारान् प्रत्ययिकान् शूरान् भक्तान् विगत साध्वसान् ।इतो गच्चत रामस्य व्यवसायम् परीक्षथ ॥६-२९-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: cārān pratyayikān śūrān bhaktān vigata sādhvasān ।ito gaccata rāmasya vyavasāyam parīkṣatha ॥6-29-20॥।।

translations.english: "From here you go and reach there you may observe perceptions of Rama and of others close to him, his ministers and those who have reached there in affection to him."
translations.hindi: तुम लोग यहाँ से श्रीरामचन्द्र के पात जाओ और पता लगाओ कि, उनका इरादा किस समय क्या क्या करने का है। उनके अन्तरंगमंत्रो जो प्रीतिवश उनके साथ आये हैं, उनके कासा की भी टोह लगाना

verses.sloka: मन्त्रेष्व् अभ्यन्तरा ये अस्य प्रीत्या तेन समागताः ।कथम् स्वपिति जागर्ति किम् अन्यच् च करिष्यति ॥६-२९-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: mantreṣv abhyantarā ye asya prītyā tena samāgatāḥ ।katham svapiti jāgarti kim anyac ca kariṣyati ॥6-29-21॥।।

translations.english: "You may see how he goes to sleep, how he wakes up etc., what he does, everything. You may come after knowing everything."
translations.hindi: राम क्या अकेले सोते हैं अथधा वे सोते हैं ओर अन्य लोग सोने के समय जाग कर उनकी रखवाली करते है ? आगे वे क्या करने वाले हैं-इन सब बातों का चुपके चुपके पता लगा कर, चले आना

verses.sloka: विज्ञाय निपुणम् सर्वम् आगन्तव्यम् अशेषतः ।चारेण विदितः शत्रुः पण्डितैर् वसुधा अधिपैः ॥६-२९-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: vijñāya nipuṇam sarvam āgantavyam aśeṣataḥ ।cāreṇa viditaḥ śatruḥ paṇḍitair vasudhā adhipaiḥ ॥6-29-22॥।।

translations.english: "Wise kings of the land, having known about enemies from the spies destroy enemies in war with little effort."
translations.hindi: क्योंकि जो राजा चतुर होते ह्वै, वे दूतां ही के द्वारा अपने बैरी का सब हाल जान कर, रण में अस्पप्रयास ही से, शत्र, को भगा देते है

verses.sloka: युद्धे स्वल्पेन यत्नेन समासाद्य निरस्यते ।चारास् तु ते तथा इति उक्त्वा प्रहृष्टा राक्षस ईश्वरम् ॥६-२९-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: yuddhe svalpena yatnena samāsādya nirasyate ।cārās tu te tathā iti uktvā prahṛṣṭā rākṣasa īśvaram ॥6-29-23॥।।

translations.english: The spies then gladly uttered the words 'be it so', went round the king in reverence and departed with Saardula leading in front.
translations.hindi: चरो ने “ जो आज्ञा ” कह कर और शादूल नामक चर को अपना अगुआ बना कर तथा प्रसन्न हो कर राक्षसेश्‍वर की प्रदक्षिणा की

verses.sloka: शार्दूलमग्रतः कृत्वा ततश्चक्रुः प्रदक्षिणम् ।ततस्तम् तु महात्मानम् चारा राक्षससत्तमम् ॥६-२९-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: śārdūlamagrataḥ kṛtvā tataścakruḥ pradakṣiṇam ।tatastam tu mahātmānam cārā rākṣasasattamam ॥6-29-24॥।।

translations.english: Then the spies circumambulated the great Rakshasa king and having done so went to the place where Rama and Lakshmana were stationed.
translations.hindi: तब वे चर लोग राक्षसोत्तम रावण की परिक्रमा कर वहाँ गए जहाँ लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ठहरे हुए थे

verses.sloka: कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् जग्मुर् यत्र रामः सलक्ष्मणः ।ते सुवेलस्य शैलस्य समीपे राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥६-२९-२५॥।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam jagmur yatra rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ।te suvelasya śailasya samīpe rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥6-29-25॥।।

translations.english: Reaching the Suvela mountain in disguise, they saw Rama and Lakshmana along with Sugriva and Vibheeshana.

verses.sloka: प्रच्चन्ना ददृशुर् गत्वा ससुग्रीव विभीषणौ ।प्रेक्षमाणाश्चमूम् ताम् च बभूवुर्भयविह्वलाः ॥६-२९-२६॥।।
verses.transliteration: praccannā dadṛśur gatvā sasugrīva vibhīṣaṇau ।prekṣamāṇāścamūm tām ca babhūvurbhayavihvalāḥ ॥6-29-26॥।।

translations.english: Those Rakshasas were bewildered with fear on looking at the army. Righteous Vibheeshana recognized them on seeing them.
translations.hindi: ओर वे “जय जय” कह रावण को प्रणाम कर वहाँ से चले ` गए । तदनन्तर पास बैठे हुए महोदर से रावण ने कहा

verses.sloka: ते तु धर्म आत्मना दृष्टा राक्षस इन्द्रेण राक्षसाः ।विभीषणेन तत्रस्था निगृहीता यदृच्चया ॥६-२९-२७॥।।
verses.transliteration: te tu dharma ātmanā dṛṣṭā rākṣasa indreṇa rākṣasāḥ ।vibhīṣaṇena tatrasthā nigṛhītā yadṛccayā ॥6-29-27॥।।

translations.english: By chance Vibheeshana seized Saardula, the evil Rakshasa who was moving in that army.

verses.sloka: शार्दूलो ग्राहितस्त्वेकः पापोऽयमिति राक्षसः ।मोक्षितः सोऽपि रामेण वध्यमानः प्लवङ्गमैः ॥६-२९-२८॥।।
verses.transliteration: śārdūlo grāhitastvekaḥ pāpo'yamiti rākṣasaḥ ।mokṣitaḥ so'pi rāmeṇa vadhyamānaḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ ॥6-29-28॥।।

translations.english: As the monkeys attempted to kill him (Saardula), compassionate Rama released him and also the other Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: ॥ १ निणहीताः=तर्जिताइत्यर्थः | ( गोऽ ) २ यहच्छया-शार्द,ला- तिरिक्तारादसाविभीषणेनदृष्टा अपियहच्छुया विभ्रीषणाज्ञांविनेवण्द्दीताः- शार्द,लस्तु अयमत्यन्तपापइतिकपिभिग्रीहितः | ( रा ) \ A ॥ क्षय 5 शं “ न एकोनत्रिशः सगः २५७ मोचितः सोऽपि रामेण वध्यमानः सवड्ठमेः | आ।नृऽशस्यन रामस्य मोचिता राक्षसा; परे ॥२८]| वानर तो उसको मार डालना चाहते थे, किन्तु श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उसे छुड़वा दिया। इसी प्रकार अन्य राक्षसचरों को भी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की दया ने छुड़वा दिया

verses.sloka: अनृशम्सेन रामेण मोक्षिता राक्षसाः सरे ।वानरैर् अर्दितास् ते तु विक्रान्तैर् लघु विक्रमैः ॥६-२९-२९॥।।
verses.transliteration: anṛśamsena rāmeṇa mokṣitā rākṣasāḥ sare ।vānarair arditās te tu vikrāntair laghu vikramaiḥ ॥6-29-29॥।।

translations.english: Harassed by the valorous and swift Vanaras, those Rakshasas lost their senses and returned to Lanka gasping and panting.

verses.sloka: पुनर् लंकाम् अनुप्राप्ताः श्वसन्तो नष्ट चेतसः ।ततो दशग्रीवम् उपस्थितास् ते ।चारा बहिर् नित्य चरा निशा चराः ।गिरेः सुवेलस्य समीप वासिनम् ।न्यवेदयन् भीम बलम् महाबलाः ॥६-२९-३०॥
verses.transliteration: punar laṁkām anuprāptāḥ śvasanto naṣṭa cetasaḥ ।tato daśagrīvam upasthitās te ।cārā bahir nitya carā niśā carāḥ ।gireḥ suvelasya samīpa vāsinam ।nyavedayan bhīma balam mahābalāḥ ॥6-29-30॥

translations.english: Then those mighty night-ranging spies, ever ranging outside, reported to the ten-necked one the army of Rama that lay near the Suvela mountain.
translations.hindi: इति एको नत्रिशः सगः Es _. तदनन्तर, परराष्ट्रो का वृत्तान्त जानने के लिए सदा घूसनेः फिरने चाले उन राक्षसचरो ने दशानन रावण के पास जा, सुवे पवत के समीप छावनी डाले हुए पड़ी हुई भयङ्कर बानर- वाहिनी का वृत्तान्त कहा
